introduction: Yellow and Red, planned to travel to Hwaseong, Gyeonggi-do (One of the cities in South Korean, a reference since the show is created in South Korea by TubaN) for summer vacation and get on the bus to Hwaseong. However, the bus that they get on was not for Hwaseong, Gyeonggi-do, but the bus was for Planet Mars Research Institute. When Yellow and Red arrive at the lab they meet Mars researchers there (Mars in Korean is also Hwaseong). The researchers told Yellow and Red "Bring a Martian to Earth and i'll give you a sausage!". Fell for the words, Yellow and Red board to a spaceship that heading to Mars.Arrived on Mars, Yellow and Red met the Martians. They tell them about "Earth" and also told them there could be only one of them that can be taken back to Earth. The Martians interested and start showing off themselves to get to "fantastic planet Earth" that they imagined. The story will be about who will Yellow and Red bring back to earth after a long series of the Martians making sure that they are eligible to be on earth.
